title: Poison/zero-credit user reverts the whole migrateIn slice (non-atomic per-user deposit loop)
description: A single parked user whose amt haircuts to zero credit reverts the whole migrateIn slice via story-011's require(credited>0) (StableStaker.sol:632) inside the migrator's all-or-nothing loop (InPlaceMigrator.sol:207-224), which has no per-user try/catch. Root cause is the migrator's non-atomic loop, NOT the (correctly-fixed) guard; this is a downstream consequence of the eae10d60/story-011 guard existing, not a regression. Distinct from 59eebbf8 (unbounded-gas DoS on StableStaker.batchMigrate) by both contract:function and rootCauseClass.
impact: No principal loss. Migration availability/completeness only: the operator must re-page around the poison user; every parked user recovers full principal via claimTimedOut (InPlaceMigrator.sol:239-256). Double-gated preconditions (haircutting strategy AND a position that rounds to zero credit). Conjoined to M-01 (ss12m1) on the haircutting-strategy precondition.
recommendation: Either wrap the per-user depositFor in a try/catch that skips (and leaves parked / emits an event for) a zero-credit user instead of reverting the whole slice, or pre-filter zero-credit users out of the batch. Document that re-injection through a haircutting strategy can revert on dust positions.
